title: Comments of Jull Hardee in opposition to the Cook Inlet Subsea-Compute and Infrastructure Hub Project under P-15423.

documents.name: DocBatch261109-0012.pdf
documents.text:
nGINAL
 October 21, 2026



 United States of America

 Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

 Deep Green Cook Inlet SN, LLC                        Docket #P.15423-000

                                                      Project No. 15423-000



 To: Debbie Anne A. Reese, Secretary, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

 888 First St. N.E., Room 1A, Washington, DC 20426



 I protest this Cook Inlet Subsea-Compute and Infrastructure HUB Project (Deep Green
 Project) to be located in the Upper Cook Inlet, East Foreland Corridor, Kenai Peninsula
 Borough, Alaska.

 I think a data center in an important water way for marine life including Beluga Whales that
 are endangered is a terrible idea. This waterway is a significant part of our community in
 multiple ways. We depend on marine life in this water way for subsistence, and others use
 it for their livelihood for commercial fishing. It is a true sense of identity to our local
 community. Our arctic waters are already heating up and starting to change our
 ecosystems and way of life. This will further threaten and speed up the destruction of our
 waterways. Our local community is very interconnected with this waterway in multiple
 ways and we are greatly worried about the beluga whales who are already endangered.



 Thank yoL fpb-your attenti n in this matter
